messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: kvcache-continuous-batching alert for cluster prod-west-1. Memory growth + request queue depth rising. Autoscale not keeping pace. CRITICAL -> potential degrade for streaming/generation routes. paging: @oncall-alice :rotating_light:

oncall-alice: saw the alert. p99 for text generation jumped from ~120ms to ~1.2s on /v1/generate during the last 6m. queue length on runtime-34 -> 520 requests pending, KV cache mem +700% over baseline. tagging affected customers: acme-corp, pilot-saas. I'm taking ownership.

oncall-alice: quick ask: anyone recently rolled speculative-decoding on model-group `redwood-v2-compat`? that could cause extra KV entries if draft/target diverge. @eng-ml-rajesh?

eng-ml-rajesh: pushed a config change for speculative_decode=true on that model-group ~14:10 today to improve latency in light loads. didn't expect interaction with continuous batching. rolling back suspicious?

oncall-alice: ok do that. immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable speculative decoding on prod model-group 2) reduce continuous batch max_size to 8 on affected nodes 3) trigger KV cache aggressive eviction (LRU shrink) 4) monitor queue and p99 for 10m.

oncall-alice: commands I'm going to run now:
```
# rollback speculative flag
redwoodctl models update --group redwood-v2-compat --set speculative_decode=false --env prod
# tune batching
redwoodctl runtime update --node runtime-34 --set continuous_batch.max_size=8
# force eviction
redwoodctl cache evict --cluster prod-west-1 --policy lru --target-percent 50
```

deploy-bot: Started job deploy/rollback-17421 for models:update (initiated by oncall-alice). Job URL: https://deploys.internal/17421

oncall-bob: picking up for handoff, I'm available to follow the rollout and handle pager if it persists. will watch metrics and customer threads. @sre-lin can you pre-approve scaling if needed?

sre-lin: pre-approved emergency scale. if queue > 800 I'll trigger a hot-add of a GPU node shard.

eng-runtime-chen: noted. we'll also temporarily disable prefix caching for long-sequence requests to reduce KV growth risk. pushing a runtime patch now.

oncall-alice: rollback of speculative_decode completed per deploy-bot. runtime batch size reduced. cache eviction started. metrics: p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 420ms in 2m, queue depth 520 -> 210. still elevated but trending down. marking mitigation in progress. :white_check_mark:

customer-success-maria: ping — acme-corp reported slow generation in their agent flows. I'm drafting a proactive note. Do we know customer impact window?

oncall-bob: current window ~14:04 - ongoing, peak at 14:12. degraded experience for long-streaming requests and some function-calling flows. error rate rose 0.2% -> 3.4% on generation endpoints.

eng-ml-rajesh: re: root cause hypothesis: speculative decoding creates draft branches and keeps both draft+target KV entries alive until commit; with continuous batching and increased concurrency the KV cache saw multiplicative entries per request, causing cache pressure and eviction churn and then batch retries/fallbacks that amplified queue depth. need to add guard: if continuous_batching_active -> disable speculative fork or use per-request ephemeral KV that doesn't persist.

oncall-alice: agree. immediate follow-ups we should open: ENG-RUNTIME ticket for guard + graceful degrade (disable speculative on high KV pressure), ENG-ML ticket to revert experimental spec decode default and add canary rollout gating, SRE ticket for auto-scale thresholds and alert tuning. I'll create tickets and assign.

oncall-bob: metrics update 14:22: p99 340ms, queue 95, error rate down to 0.6%. traffic shape normalizing.

eng-runtime-chen: deployed prefix-cache disable for long-seq routes. no errors observed from the change. will run a quick regression test on small sample.

deploy-bot: Job deploy/rollback-17421 succeeded.

oncall-alice: marking incident as mitigated for now. still keeping channel open for handoff and postmortem. next steps: 1) postmortem draft (oncall-alice) 2) ENG-RUNTIME PR (chen) to short-circuit speculative forks when continuous_batch.active==true 3) ENG-ML (rajesh) add rollout gate + monitoring for KV growth 4) SRE (lin) tune alert thresholds to avoid late pages for cache-pressure-only events.

customer-success-maria: I'll follow up with acme-corp with an incident summary and offer credits if they saw production impact. please add timeline and customer-facing message when available.

oncall-bob: handing off to eng-runtime-chen for long-term fix. I'll keep watch for 30m then close the pager if stable.

eng-runtime-chen: acknowledged. will start the guard PR and link to this thread. rough ETA for patch + canary: 48h.

oncall-alice: creating tickets now: ENG-3921 (speculative/continuous-batch guard), ENG-3922 (kvcache eviction policy review), SRE-1145 (autoscale threshold tuning). assigning owners.

oncall-bob: adding postmortem owners and putting a short blameless timeline into the incident tracker. good job crew, nice quick rollback & rollback-driven mitigation. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated by oncall-alice and oncall-bob. Pager cleared at 1767451602.

oncall-alice: closing thread for now. keep any follow-ups as replies here.
